We're solving consequential problems in modern software and we're doing it with a sharp team that moves fast and builds security solutions that last.

PRIME VALUES
Pillar 1
Hard problems, real impact.
Prime sits at the intersection of AI, security, and developer  tooling, some of the most complex and fast-moving territory in tech.  The work you do here directly helps security teams at companies  that you use every day such as Paypal, Elastic, Bumble, and many  more to protect what they build.
Pillar 2
A team that moves like a startup, thinks like a platform.
We are over 30 people across Israel and the US, which means you'll have real ownership of the work you’re doing, direct access to leadership, and the ability to see your work go live and make an impact.
Pillar 3
At the frontier, by design.
Agentic development is changing how software gets built. We're building the security layer for that new world, which means the work here is state of the art and the people doing it love to stay one step ahead of the game.
